results.title: InstallRecord can hold written and canary_passed true with probed false, a combination no install step produces
results.label: CONFIRMED

evidence.quote:
pub probed: bool,
pub written: bool,
pub canary_passed: bool,

results.permits: Any of the eight combinations of the three booleans.
results.reach: restore_from_journal sets written from the journal without setting probed, so a restart after a crash mid-install reaches it.
results.smallest_fix: Replace the three booleans with enum InstallState { Probed(Probe), Written(Probe, Journal), Effective(Probe, Journal, Canary) } and transitions that consume one state.

closure_proposal.detail: InstallState enum; trybuild case showing Written cannot be built without a Probe.

checked_and_sound.reason: Already one enum with one transition function.
